# Supplier Portal Requirements

## 1. Accounts
Suppliers must be able to register with a company e-mail address.
The portal shall lock an account after ten failed sign-in attempts.

## 2. Catalogue
Each product should have at least one image and a wholesale price.
Buyers can export the catalogue as CSV. See https://docs.portal.example/export for the format.

| Field | Required |
|---|---|
| SKU | yes |
| Price | yes |
